selection_metadata.rule: FIT observed-past response-macro centered truncated-LS greedy channel subset
selection_metadata.indexing: Zero-based original raw C indices; final columns in original ascending order
selection_metadata.selection_tie: Exact FP64 scalar equality then lowest original channel index
